name: ci-retained-source
goal: Fresh main checks retain immutable source reviews after squash landing

evidence: Cold single-branch clone of the exact source tree fails 12 ownership cases without archived commits and passes the same unchanged cases after fetching refs/harness/source. Actual main unchanged.
The standard Linux setup case asserts complete branch history but omits archived source refs. Extend that same setup case with read ordering before the unchanged full check.
